t: This is Africa, a sculpture by William Theed. Theed was a British sculptor, born in 1804, and the son of another sculptor and painter, also named William Theed. He specialised in portraiture, and the Royal Family made extensive use of his services. So the person who made this piece was a trusted hand at likenesses, working for some of the most prominent patrons of his day. Take a moment to look at the figure and how it has been carved.
